rows.title: Carpentry certificate
rows.old_description: Explore the training path behind Carpentry certificate, from apprenticeships and certificates to the next steps that build career-ready skill.
rows.new_takeaway: Carpentry certificates open the door to apprenticeship-eligible work — the credential isn't the finish line, it's the ticket to the much longer paid-learning path that follows.

rows.title: Carney pitches new apprenticeship grant for skilled trades
rows.old_description: Explore the training path behind Carney pitches new apprenticeship grant for skilled trades, from apprenticeships and certificates to the next steps that build career-ready skill.
rows.new_takeaway: Apprenticeship grants quietly remove the biggest barrier to trades training — the cost of unpaid first months — and the policies around them change fast enough to be worth checking before you commit.

rows.title: Applying to Fashion TMU for Fall 2026? Make your portfolio stand out.
rows.old_description: Explore the training path behind Applying to Fashion TMU for Fall 2026? Make your portfolio stand out., from apprenticeships and certificates to the next steps that build career-ready skill.
rows.new_takeaway: Creative-program portfolios are judged on point of view, not polish — admissions committees spot generic work fast, but a small body of consistent personal projects beats a glossy showpiece.

rows.title: Sheridan College. School of Skilled Trades - Plumbing
rows.old_description: Explore the training path behind Sheridan College. School of Skilled Trades - Plumbing, from apprenticeships and certificates to the next steps that build career-ready skill.
rows.new_takeaway: Plumbing programs at colleges like Sheridan are usually the first half of a longer apprenticeship — graduating gets you working, not certified, and the rest happens on real job sites.

rows.title: Welding - Skilled Trades
rows.old_description: Explore the training path behind Welding - Skilled Trades, from apprenticeships and certificates to the next steps that build career-ready skill.
rows.new_takeaway: Welding training is short enough to fit between jobs and credentialed in tiers — you can start working as a fitter or general welder and stack certifications as your skill grows.

rows.title: Architectural Technology at Humber Polytechnic
rows.old_description: Explore the training path behind Architectural Technology at Humber Polytechnic, from apprenticeships and certificates to the next steps that build career-ready skill.
rows.new_takeaway: Architectural technology programs prepare you for the production side of design — making the drawings builders actually use — which is a faster path into the industry than an architecture degree.

rows.title: Everything I learned in cosmetology schooll
rows.old_description: Explore the training path behind Hairstylist, from apprenticeships and certificates to the next steps that build career-ready skill.
rows.new_takeaway: Cosmetology school is more clinic than classroom — most of what you take into the chair comes from real client hours, not lectures, so pick a program by its practical setup.

rows.title: Real Truth about Aerospace Engineering - is it Worth it?
rows.old_description: Explore the training path behind Aerospace Engineering, from apprenticeships and certificates to the next steps that build career-ready skill.
rows.new_takeaway: Engineering degrees pay back differently depending on the field — aerospace rewards patience and depth, so it's worth it for people who already love the long arc, not the quick cycle.

rows.title: Automotive Engineering Class
rows.old_description: Explore the training path behind Automobile Technology, from apprenticeships and certificates to the next steps that build career-ready skill.
rows.new_takeaway: Automotive engineering programs now spend as much time on software and electric drivetrains as on combustion — choose a school whose curriculum reflects where the industry is going, not where it's been.

rows.title: Heavy Duty Equipment Program at Conestoga
rows.old_description: Explore the training path behind Outdoor Power and Recreation Equipment, from apprenticeships and certificates to the next steps that build career-ready skill.
rows.new_takeaway: Heavy-duty mechanic training pays off because the machines don't move to where the workers are — graduates with the right tickets travel to wherever industry needs them, and the pay reflects it.

rows.title: The Key to Choosing a Fulfilling Career
rows.old_description: Explore the training path behind Job Search, from apprenticeships and certificates to the next steps that build career-ready skill.
rows.new_takeaway: Fulfilling careers usually aren't picked from a list — they show up at the intersection of what you'll do for free and what someone will pay for, and noticing that overlap takes time.

rows.title: Learn More about Electronics Technician
rows.old_description: Explore the training path behind Electronics, from apprenticeships and certificates to the next steps that build career-ready skill.
rows.new_takeaway: Electronics technician training is mostly hands-on with real components — pick a program with a strong lab so you graduate able to diagnose, not just describe.

rows.title: Typical Day in the Life of a Canadian Engineering Student👷🏻‍♂️🇨🇦 | Western University
rows.old_description: Explore the training path behind Mechanical Engineering CAD, from apprenticeships and certificates to the next steps that build career-ready skill.
rows.new_takeaway: Engineering school is closer to a job than a university experience for most — the volume of work is real, and the people who thrive treat it like training for a profession, not picking a major.

rows.title: Woodworking, Furniture & Cabinetmaking at Humber Polytechnic
rows.old_description: Explore the training path behind Woodworking, Furniture & Cabinetmaking at Humber Polytechnic, from apprenticeships and certificates to the next steps that build career-ready skill.
rows.new_takeaway: Furniture-making programs train you for both production work and starting your own shop — the path forks early between volume cabinetry and one-off pieces, and the program choice should match the path.
